Prep time: 10 minutes Cook time: 30 minutes Total time: 40 minutes Number of Servings: 10 Ingredients 1/2 pound lean ground beef (15% fat) 1 medium onion, chopped 3 1/2 cups water 1 can (15 ounces) tomato sauce 2 teaspoons dried oregano 1/2 teaspoon sugar 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder or 2 garlic cloves 1/2 teaspoon rosemary 1/4 teaspoon pepper 2 cups (12 ounces) broken spaghetti 1 cup (4 ounces) grated parmesan cheese Directions Brown meat and onions in a large skillet over medium-high heat (300 °F in an electric skillet). Drain fat*. Stir in water, tomato sauce and spices. Bring to a boil. Add spaghetti, cover pan, and simmer 10 to 15 minutes, stirring often to prevent sticking. When spaghetti is tender, top with grated cheese. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Notes: Try ground turkey or small cooked shrimp for the meat. Try whole-wheat pasta to increase fiber. Use cheddar cheese in place of parmesan. *Pour fat from cooked meat into a metal container. Let it cool, then dispose of it in a garbage can.
